newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Meinl dividend payouts to start on Nov 15.
newsitem.headline: Meinl dividend payouts to start on Nov 15.

text.p: Hungarian food retailer Csemege -Julius Meinl said on Tuesday that dividend payouts after its 1995 earnings will run from November 15 to December 15.

In line with the decision of the company's annual general meeting earlier this year, shareholders will be paid a 13 percent dividend or 1,300 forints/share, the company said in a statement in the official bourse gazette.
Csemege-Julius Meinl is over 90 percent owned by Austria's Julius Meinl International AG.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Julius Meinl shares closed at 9,200 forints on November 4.
